subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which npm installer failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and where should the installer only print remediation guidance?
rationale: Source inspection shows a real diagnostics and recovery gap, but retrying npm failures, changing npm prefix/PATH state, and tightening optional setup probes can change first-run and upgrade behavior across platforms.

options.title: Define a narrow policy first
options.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash, local-prefix, and PowerShell tests.

options.title: Improve guidance only
options.body: Keep install behavior mostly unchanged but add clear EACCES, ENOSPC, EBADENGINE, E404, and network-error messages with docs links and next commands.

options.title: Keep current partial diagnostics
options.body: Accept the existing npm code/syscall/errno output and targeted cleanup retries without adding a broader installer error policy.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow policy first
recommendation.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash, local-prefix, and PowerShell tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the broadest recent history across the installer scripts affected by the decision.
